No running logged yet in the app, so I'm working off what you're telling me. Legs fading late in long runs is usually one of two things: the long run itself is outpacing your current endurance base, or you're starting it too fast and paying for it at the end. The fix is boring but it works — build the long run up gradually, five to ten percent longer week to week, and slow your pace on it, slower than feels necessary early on. Negative-split it if you can: easier first half, even or slightly faster second. Strength work for quads, glutes and calves helps too, since late-run fatigue is often a strength-endurance gap as much as a cardio one.

If you want, I can build that into your plan — longer easy-paced long run progression plus some leg strength work. Want me to set that up?
